You let the attack slide past your guard and bring your weapon back before your opponent recovers.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
An adjacent melee attacker, after you resolve a Standard or Strong defense against its attack.
Duration
Immediate attack after the triggering attack resolves.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a melee weapon; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Make one free Basic Melee attack against it, rolling Brawn and using Basic Melee’s outcomes. You need a melee weapon and must still be able to attack. A triggering free attack cannot trigger this free attack. No further free attacks arise from your return stroke.

Additional rulings
